short: Unit selection (M06) and own-voice concatenation (M08) are standard: an EMG design new to ECoG, never compared on its folds; 4-choice test (M12) on 30 best words; naturalness unmeasured.
position: The paper [@herff2019generating] changes the decoder (M06), selecting stored frames by cosine similarity of high-gamma features, and the waveform step (M08), concatenating the participant's own audio. Both are standard: unit selection is new to intracranial synthesis (0 of 6 earlier studies) but 6 earlier ultrasound and EMG studies used it, and the authors cite the EMG precedent [@zahner2014conversion]. The claim of superiority over more complex approaches is unsupported: no comparator runs on the paper's folds, and the authors concede slightly lower correlations than the same group's DenseNet on the same recordings [@angrick2019speech], a sibling method presented with unit selection in May 2018 [@huggins2019workshops]. The listener test (M12) is standard; four options on the 30 best-correlated words support intelligibility only for those words, and naturalness is not measured.
